caveats: Sea cells (3311 of 3600 region cells) had finite SST on all 92 target days; the 289 non-sea cells (persistent land/no-data) are set to 0. Baseline 1992-2002 pools used +/-5-day windows, including 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05; all pool values were finite so NaN-ignoring was never triggered. Two regional MHW events were detected in 2019.
